title: Expiry, discontinuation and renewal reminders on the Prescriptions & Renewals line
content:
**Medication Management Office standard — Prescriptions & Renewals.**

**1. Expiry.** A prescription expires the day after its expiration date whether or not fills remain; unfilled fills are voided with reason "expired". The expiry is recorded as of the day after the expiration date.

**2. Discontinuation.** A prescription is discontinued when the prescriber stops the medication, when the patient asks to stop it, when a new strength replaces it, or when care moves to an outside practice; remaining fills are voided with reason "discontinued".

**3. A patient's request to stop.** A patient's request to stop a medication is recorded as asked but is sent to the prescriber for acknowledgement, and it never discontinues other prescriptions.

**4. Reminders and lead time.** Refill reminders go out the class's reminder days before the estimated run-out, and patients are asked to request renewals the class's lead time in business days ahead.

**Illustration of clause 1 (hypothetical).** A Monitored Maintenance Prescription with an expiration date of 30 April and 1 fill still authorized expires on 1 May; the remaining fill is voided with reason "expired" that day. On 30 April itself the prescription is still active.

**Illustration of clause 3 (hypothetical).** A patient holding three prescriptions asks by phone to stop one of them. The request is recorded as asked for that one prescription and sent to its prescriber for acknowledgement; the other two prescriptions are unaffected.
